|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E3, the current text (version 4 of 4): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List, official text as of 27 April 2013. It is the last publication of this card, so it is current; it is listed as its own version because it was published (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even one that repeats an earlier text word for word; whatever was published last is current). The image here is the Master List slip.
* '''Original''' ([[Commander Praji (V) (Virtual Block 1)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 1 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009).<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=2 Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 2, slip 04. During your control phase (twice if aboard Devastator), may use 1 force to ▲ an Imperial pilot of ability < 3.” Document: the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB1-04-Commander_Praji.png]]) prints slip number “04” bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Commander Praji (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text) changed “2. During your” to “2. Once during your”, changed “if aboard Devastator),” to “if on Devastator)”, changed “1 force to” to “1 Force to” and changed “take an Imperial” to “take any Imperial”.<ref name="cl-1210_4-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref> Full text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Once during your control phase (twice if on Devastator) may use 1 Force to take any Imperial pilot of ability < 3 into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” The PC website card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so its wording follows that data; it is listed as a version because the PC published it.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Commander Praji (V) (Virtual Block 1) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-D-commanderpraji-pre.gif]]), on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date)<ref name="pcimg-Virtual1-Dark">Players Committee card image, file <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/commanderpraji.gif</code>; the directory listing of this folder (Virtual1-Dark) was not captured; the captured Legacy folders (Virtual2, Virtual4, Virtual5, Virtual6, Virtual7) all carry 25-Feb-2013 11:33/11:34, the date the PC rebuilt its image set (research R6, 11 November 2026: these are bulk upload dates, and an image may have been made earlier). Today's copy: https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/legacy/VirtualBlock1-Dark/large/commanderpraji.gif</ref>: “[Pilot] 2. During your control phase (twice if aboard Devastator), may use 1 force to ▲ an Imperial pilot of ability < 3.” '''What changed:''' the PC card image prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word, after the PC website card list (PC-E1) had published a different text. It is listed as its own version, placed at its upload date (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The date is only the folder's bulk upload date: the image may have been made earlier, so its place in the order is uncertain, but the versioning order follows the upload date. Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and the Virtual Block 1 set mark) and prints the number “04” bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
